- [USER] The user is looking for tips on how to reduce water waste in the shower.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips for reducing water waste in the shower, including:
  1. Take shorter showers (5-10 minutes).
  2. Install a low-flow showerhead (2.5 gallons per minute or less).
  3. Turn off the water while soaping up (saves up to 2 gallons per minute).
  4. Use a shower timer or pause button.
  5. Take a "Navy shower" (wet, turn off, lather, rinse).
  6. Use a showerhead with a built-in flow restrictor.
  7. Take a "warm-up" shower with low flow.
  8. Fix leaks (a dripping faucet can waste up to 20 gallons per day).
  9. Use a shower bucket to collect excess water.
  10. Consider a showerhead with water-saving technology.
